system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: Special

You flicker between enemies, striking when they least expect it.

Choose up to three creatures. The first target must be within 5 spaces of you. Each subsequent target must be within 5 spaces of the last target and have a clear path between them.

You teleport to each one, making a single Melee attack against each. This is a Multi-Attack, with the Defense of each target decreased by -1.

At the end of the last attack, you may appear at an unobstructed space of your choosing within 5 spaces of the last target.

When you use this ability, you may spend an additional 1 Resolve to make your attacks to ignore Armor.
